ios.desc:
Download LUISAVIAROMA for the best shopping experience and find a curated selection of women's, kids' and men's designer clothes, eyewear, footwear, accessories, beauty, home and more. Discover over 500 brands like Khaite, Coperni, Jacquemus, The Row, Dolce & Gabbana, Maison Margiela, Ganni and more.

CUSTOM FEED
Explore a personalized homepage based on your favorite items and brands: from Stella McCartney purses and Jil Sander knitwear to adidas sneakers and Chloé blouses.

QUICK VIEW
Scroll through product images without ever leaving the catalogue page. Quick view allows you to see all available product images in one place for a hassle-free shopping experience.

SHOP THE LOOK
Recreate the magic of our expert stylists by shopping total looks. 

COMPLETE YOUR LOOK
Click on the magnifying glass icon to discover similar items and how to complete your look. Don't know how to style your Marge Sherwood bag or your new Paris Texas boots? Use the magnifying glass to discover the best styling combinations.

EXCLUSIVE OFFERS ONLY ON THE APP
Enable push notifications to receive exclusive promos only for LVR App users. Be the first to discover promos for Black Friday, Cyber Monday, Holiday Sales, and more.

We will also send you personalized notifications based on your tastes. Don't miss the launch of LVR-exclusive items, new collections, and selections curated by the LVR team on current trends. 

LOYALTY PROGRAM
Join the LVR Privilege Program and start earning LVR Points to receive exclusive rewards.

VIRTUAL TRY-ON
Try on selected sunglasses virtually — see the fit, find your frame, all from your screen.

BUY CONSCIOUSLY AND SUSTAINABLY
LVRSUSTAINABLE is thoughtful shopping within LUISAVIAROMA where you can find a curated selection of the best conscious brands. Discover sustainable clothes, eyewear, shoes & sneakers from brands like Veja, Stella McCartney, and many more.

SHOP FOR YOUR LITTLE ONES
Shop LUISAVIAROMA Kids on the app. Explore mini-me collections from your favorite designer brands and discover new favorites with a curated offering from Molo, Liewood, Bonpoint, Bobo Choses, and more. Discover the full range of clothing, shoes, and accessories for children 0-16 years old. 

HOME
Explore stylish household items from Dolce & Gabbana, Lisa Corti, Missoni, Alessi, and many others.

DOWNLOAD THE LVR APP NOW! Get the best out of your shopping experience!
